rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese way to say that snow is falling.
This is the all-purpose noun for snow, snowfall, or snow lying on the ground.

example.english: I went to Hokkaido to see snow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 bak1 hoi2 dou6 tai2 syut3

rows.note: Use 雪花 for individual snowflakes and for the snow-like static pattern on a screen.

example.english: A few flakes of snow are drifting by the window.
example.jyutping: coeng1 bin1 piu1 zyu6 gei2 pin3 syut3 faa1

rows.note: Use 雪白色 when referring specifically to the snow-white color as a color term.

example.english: I chose curtains in the color of snow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan2 zo2 syut3 baak6 sik1 ge3 coeng1 lim4
